visual_action: A montage of clips shows former President Barack Obama at a campaign rally. He walks through a large, cheering crowd of supporters who are filming him with their phones. He gets on stage, waves, and then high-fives and hugs another man, who appears to be Tim Walz. They stand together on stage as the crowd continues to cheer. Supporters are holding campaign signs.

cast.name: Barack Obama
cast.evidence: Barack Obama is the central figure shown throughout the video, and on-screen text reads 'President Obama is BACK on the campaign trail 😎'.

cast.name: Tim Walz
cast.evidence: Campaign signs in the crowd read 'HARRIS WALZ'. The man Obama greets on stage is presumably Tim Walz, Kamala Harris's running mate.

cast.name: Kamala Harris
cast.evidence: Campaign signs visible in the crowd read 'HARRIS WALZ' and 'HARRIS 2024'.

on_screen_text.text: President Obama is BACK on the campaign trail 😎

spoken_summary: There is no speech in the video; it consists only of music.
audio_music: An upbeat, bass-boosted, patriotic instrumental track ('Star Spangled (Bass Boosted)') plays throughout the video, creating an energetic and hype-filled atmosphere.
editing_pacing: The video is a short montage of clips from different angles, showing Barack Obama's arrival and appearance on stage.
central_claim: Barack Obama is actively and energetically campaigning for the Democratic ticket, bringing his popular appeal to the race.
intended_effect: To generate excitement and enthusiasm for the Democratic campaign by showcasing the popular former president, Barack Obama, actively supporting it.
